| MPSC `Rx::close` | Senders awaiting `closed()` may hang. [chan.rs:258](tokio/src/sync/mpsc/chan.rs:258) |
| Broadcast `Receiver::drop` | Dropping the last receiver may fail to wake `Sender::closed()`. [broadcast.rs:1595](tokio/src/sync/broadcast.rs:1595) |
| Watch `Receiver::drop` | Last-receiver shutdown notification may fail. [watch.rs:1019](tokio/src/sync/watch.rs:1019) |

| Callers | Most important impact |
|---|---|
| `get`, `contains`, `in_bulk`, `bulk_update`, `dates`, `datetimes`, `__or__`, `__xor__`, `_handle_order_with_respect_to` — [query.py](django/db/models/query.py) | Incorrect retrieval, membership, batching, bulk updates, date lists, and queryset combinations. |
| Generated `Manager.filter` proxy — [manager.py:85](django/db/models/manager.py#L85) | Changes reach ordinary `Model.objects.filter(...)` calls throughout Django and applications. |
| `refresh_from_db`, `_save_table`, `_do_update`, uniqueness/date checks, next/previous and ordering helpers — [base.py](django/db/models/base.py) | **Write correctness:** wrong predicates can update unintended rows; validation and refresh can select incorrect objects. |
| Relation filtering, prefetching, related-manager `add`/`remove`/clear helpers — [related_descriptors.py](django/db/models/fields/related_descriptors.py); foreign-key `validate` — [related.py:1223](django/db/models/fields/related.py#L1223) | Incorrect related objects, broken prefetching, or unintended relationship changes. |

| Admin search/actions, auth permissions, session lookup/cleanup, generic relations, migration recording — [admin/options.py](django/contrib/admin/options.py), [auth/backends.py](django/contrib/auth/backends.py), [sessions/backends/db.py](django/contrib/sessions/backends/db.py), [contenttypes/fields.py](django/contrib/contenttypes/fields.py), [recorder.py](django/db/migrations/recorder.py) | Incorrect access/results, action targets, cleanup, or migration state. |
